name: TCL 50P615
summary: TCL 50P615 ships with TCL analytics, pushed content and promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Greek set runs Android TV 11 and ships with TCL analytics, home screen recommendation rows, partner app attribution and a partner app auto installer. TCL also pushes content onto the home screen at boot, runs a TCL Channel web feed, sends messages and promos and has a retail demo sticker. Google Assistant and voice helpers are also listed.

The list was applied in five batches with a screenshot after each. After one reboot nothing came back on. Settings, Wi-Fi, the Inputs menu, app tiles and every button on the real remote worked. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Tuner and HDMI (the TCL input service)
Remote buttons including Home, Input and Settings
notes: Apps already switched off at the factory, such as the UK catch-up apps, are left alone.
Install a replacement home screen first, then turn off the stock one.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 50P615?
faq.a: Not with the default list. It turns off Google Assistant, voice search and the TCL voice service. Switch them back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL content pushes, the web content feed, the pushed messages and promos and the recommendation rows.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Android TV home screen back.
